name: Follow Me Koisuru Kimochi
original_name: Follow Me 恋するきもち
source:
When first love comes, it's hard to convey own feelings to the partner. Main character receives an anonymous love letter. There are five girls who could be the sender, so hero begins his investigation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
初恋来临时，很难将自己的心意传达给对方。主角收到了一封匿名情书。有五个女孩可能是寄信人，于是他开始展开调查。

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
